newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU authorises British coal aid.
newsitem.headline: EU authorises British coal aid.

text.p: The European Commission said on Wednesday it had authorised Britain to provide 891 million pounds ($1.4 billion) to its coal industry through July 2002.

The money will cover liabilities inherited from the period before the British Coal Corporation was privatised, including environmental damage caused by mining activities and obligations to former workers such as pension schemes and social welfare benefits, it said.

"The aim of the aid is to ensure that inherited liabilities, in particular those resulting from the very large size of the British Coal Corporation, do not place a burden on mines with prospects of economic viability," the Commission said in a statement. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
